chapter: Instruments, first jobs and the regional scene
title: First paid jobs as a teenage pupil
summary: Roque and Buddy Petit sometimes took him on jobs at 14 or 15 for a dollar or two while bands earned three to five dollars.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: When you were studying clarinet with Manuel Roque and Isadore Fritz(?), did you play in any bands then,
No, once in a while Manuel would take me on a job, or Buddy Petit -- and gave me two dollars.
I was going to ask you: Did you get paid?
I'm talking about after I got to be about 15 years old, though -- 14 or 15 years old.
Oh, they got three to four dollars, sometimes five dollars.
Depending on the size of the crowd, or...?

It's according to the size of the crowd, yeah. A lot of times they played percentage deals. But I think when they played... They would play for as cheap as three dollars, and when I went with them sometimes they would give me a dollar, or give me two dollars
Of course, you were just glad to playing anyway...
They just took me along as Manuel's pupil or something like that, or they knew my Dad was always good for a pair of rubber heels or half-soles.
